grammar.summary: 本课学习 be going to 结构表打算，以及将来时间的表达。

points.title: be going to 打算
points.explanation: am/is/are going to + 动词原形，表示计划或打算做某事，是将来时最常用的口语形式。

examples.en: I'm going to make a bookcase.
What are you going to do now?

points.title: What colour...? 询问颜色（复习）
points.explanation: 计划中的选择用 What colour are you going to paint it? 询问。

examples.en: I'm going to paint it pink.
